style: Photorealistic editorial fashion photograph for a luxury Kerala bridal styling brand. Shot on a medium-format camera, 85mm lens, natural warm window light, soft shadows, warm slightly desaturated colour grade, subtle film grain, ivory, deep burgundy and antique gold palette. Realistic skin texture and realistic hands with five fingers. Sarees must be draped correctly with neat pleats. No text, no captions, no labels, no watermark, no logo, no borders.
